messages:
sam_cs: Heads-up — I drafted a short client priming playbook for high-risk onboarding customers. Focus is prefill/prefetch, warm pools, and quick telemetry checks so we avoid surge degradation and reduce renewal risk. Sharing here for feedback. :memo:

tara: this looks great, can we add a one-click checklist for PM handoff and schedule of enablement calls? :+1:

maria: add a telemetry tag we can filter on in console: `cs.onboard_id` + `client_tier`. that helped us find warmup gaps last quarter.

sam_cs: good call. included below. also added a tiny troubleshooting section for streaming timeouts.

kevin: quick note on batching — recommend starting with `batch_size=8` for conv workloads and bump to 16 for non-chat. include sample config?

sam_cs: included sample. see snippet:```yaml
warm_pool: true
warm_pool_size: 4
prefetch: true
prefetch_keys: ["starter_prompt","tenant_prompt"]
batching:
  policy: adaptive
  min_batch: 4
  target_latency_ms: 120
telemetry_tags: ["cs.onboard_id","client_tier","prefill_flow"]
stream_fallback: true
```

josh: love the telemetry tags. for renewal-risk scoring add a quick rubric: `green` = >90% success, `yellow` = 70-90% + seeking help, `red` = <70% or repeat errors. capture in CRM as `onboard_health`.

maria: capture feedback at day 1, day 7, and day 30. send a short NPS plus 2 quick questions: "prefill helped?" and "did streaming degrade?" link to form: https://forms.redwood/cs-feedback

sam_cs: coordination checklist (one-line items for CS):
- preflight: ensure keys + network egress, KMS ok, console telemetry tag enabled
- prefill/prefetch: seed top 10 prompts, warm_pool=true, run a 5-min smoke test
- enablement: schedule 30m product walkthrough within 48h of go-live
- surge plan: enable stream_fallback and set reserve_quota=10%
- telemetry: create dashboard with `cs.onboard_id` filter + token-level latency histogram
- renewal checkins: set renewal_risk flag if `onboard_health` is red OR support tickets >3 in 14d

tara: can ops-bot auto-create the dashboard? @ops-bot any quick command?

ops-bot: run `ops create-dashboard --filter=cs.onboard_id:<id> --metrics=latency,tokens,errors` — will return a dashboard URL. :robot_face:

kevin: troubleshooting notes to add: if streaming timeout >= 2% on smoke test -> increase `target_latency_ms` by 20ms or reduce `min_batch`. if token errors spike then enable rollback to quantized model variant.

sam_cs: final ask: CS folks, please test this with your next 2 onboarding customers and paste short results here (success/fail + any follow-ups). I'll iterate based on real feedback. thanks! :raised_hands:
